newsitem.title: USA: Transcontinental Gas asks FERC for more capacity.
newsitem.headline: Transcontinental Gas asks FERC for more capacity.

text.p: Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Corp, a unit of Williams Cos Inc, said Wednesday it filed an application with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) to increase capacity on its system by 87,070 dekatherms per day to provide additional annual firm transportation capacity to serve markets in Georgia.

The proposed $68 million Cherokee Expansion Project calls for about 11 miles of a 48-inch pipeline, about four miles of 16-inch pipeline replacement, a new compressor station, and a new compressor unit. The facilities are required to increase capacity on Transco's mainline, and the targeted in-service date is Nov 1, 1998.
